name: Beetmachine (VST3)
description: The kit that plays the three drum synthesisers. Eight slots, each empty or holding a real Kickstart, Snare Tactics or Hats Off, and a click on a slot opens that drum's own full panel underneath. A MIDI pattern from C3 upwards, or on the General MIDI notes, plays a whole kit. Any slot can cut off any other, so a closed hat chokes the open one; each slot has its level, pan, mute and solo, and goes to the stereo mix, to its own output, or both. Empty slots cost nothing. Twenty-four themed kits, from STUDIO and 808 to DUB SPACE, DNB, DOOM, BLACK METAL and HARD TECHNO, many with their own BWFX rack.
note: Windows VST3 + standalone · build 260926.7 · free download · 8 slots · Kickstart, Snare Tactics, Hats Off inside · chokes · 8 extra outputs · 24 kits · BWFX rack · manual included.
